title: Contradiction type
description: Explicit conflict register — surfaces disagreements between sources rather than silently resolving them.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Use 'active' for unresolved contradictions.

superseded_by.description: Slug of the resolution page (decision or concept). Set when the contradiction is closed.

superseded_on.description: ISO 8601 date when the contradiction was resolved

accountable_owner.description: Person or team responsible for resolution

raised_on.description: ISO 8601 date when the contradiction was first recorded

source_ids.description: Slugs of the pages whose claims conflict. Flat array — nested statement objects go in the body.

x-wiki-types.contradiction: Explicit conflict register — surfaces disagreements between sources rather than silently resolving them
